% rmd-latex-header.tex — injected into LaTeX preamble for PDF output

\usepackage{booktabs}       % professional table rules (\toprule, \midrule, \bottomrule)
\usepackage{longtable}      % tables that span multiple pages
\usepackage{float}          % H float specifier for figures
\usepackage{hyperref}       % clickable links in PDF

% XeLaTeX font setup (Inter for body, JetBrains Mono for code)
% Requires: tlmgr install fontspec inter jetbrainsmono
\usepackage{fontspec}
\setmainfont{Inter}[
  BoldFont       = Inter-Bold,
  ItalicFont     = Inter-Italic,
  BoldItalicFont = Inter-BoldItalic
]
\setmonofont{JetBrainsMono-Regular}[Scale=0.875]

% Fallback: comment out fontspec block above if fonts not installed,
% and uncomment below for safe system fonts:
% \usepackage{lmodern}

% Okabe-Ito colors for hyperlinks
\hypersetup{
  colorlinks = true,
  linkcolor  = {0072B2},    % blue
  urlcolor   = {0072B2},
  citecolor  = {D55E00}     % vermillion
}

% Tighter list spacing
\usepackage{enumitem}
\setlist{noitemsep, topsep=4pt}

% Better paragraph spacing
\setlength{\parskip}{0.5em}
\setlength{\parindent}{0em}
